extra.name: GPS Speedometer
extra.author: LOCOSP
extra.description: Live speed + heading from your GPS fix.
extra.about: Shows your current ground speed in km/h and a compass heading, computed from successive GPS fixes (haversine between the last two positions over elapsed time). Requires a valid GPS fix; shows satellite count and raw lat/lon at the bottom. A reference extra demonstrating the one-shot sensor-read shape of the EXTRAS ctx API: ctx.gps.fix(), ctx.now(), drawing and keyboard input. Press [R] to reset the smoothed speed.
